note: The escape hatch: the command is the first user arg, so 'my-agent' here is the test's argv rather than a fixed binary. OPENAI_API_BASE is set alongside OPENAI_BASE_URL for pre-1.0 SDKs and ports. TYPESAFE_BASE_URL is a /forward/ rather than a bare proxy base: no wire dialect claims /v1/systemone, so an unclaimed path aimed at the bare base goes to whichever OpenAI-shaped upstream the run configured and 404s. The forward carries the real destination; the user's own TYPESAFE_BASE_URL still wins, which redirected_env_vars does not cover because the fallback is what this entry pins.
